title: Randomized and Recommissioned Battery Dataset
citation: Fricke, Nascimento, Corbetta, Kulkarni, Viana (2023), An Accelerated Life Testing Dataset for Lithium-Ion Batteries With Constant and Variable Loading Conditions, NASA NTRS 20230014884
notes: NASA documents measured voltage, current and temperature channels and the pack-level CSV organization. The reviewed landing page/data description does not state a per-observation calibrated sensor uncertainty. Raw rows therefore remain non-admissible dataset observations until calibration/uncertainty and the complete Forge operating context are supplied. Calibration and validation splits must be by whole battery pack, never random rows from the same pack.
